domain: fixed z>0; meromorphic epsilon continuation from 1/2<Re(eps)<1
normalization: prepared fixed CA^2*CF channel, sym=4, exactly one exp(-3*EulerGamma*eps)

full_epsilon.convergence: real 1/2<eps<1 and z>0; finite inner sum first; then meromorphic continuation

hlog_encoding: rational coefficient, word over [0,-1], zeta_powers in [2,3,5]
hlog_convention: Hlog is the real iterated integral at z>0; Hlog(z,[0]*n)=log(z)^n/n!
